name: WallpaperManager.getDrawable
author: ldh0423
description:
阻止应用获取当前屏幕壁纸
Hides the current wallpaper from getDrawable(); getDrawable(int) of Android 14 and later needs the definition WallpaperManager.getDrawable/which; getFastDrawable, peekDrawable, peekFastDrawable and getWallpaperFile still return it.
luaScript:
function before(hook, param)
    param:setResult(nil)
    return true
end
